summary: NOVONIX Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching an Appendix 2A application to quote 32,566 ordinary shares on the ASX. The shares are issued upon conversion of 47,572 performance rights under an employee incentive scheme, with no cash consideration. The conversion dates are April 27, 2026, and the shares rank equally with existing ordinary shares. This is a routine employee equity vesting and listing application—no premium, no tender, no change of control. There is no special-situation event; it is an ordinary capital-structure maintenance filing.
